letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai feels brighter knowing I’ll soon be back to our warm Ahmedabad evenings with you, my cutie. Today, as the city hums with summer’s golden glow, I’m reminded how our love, celebrated on that unforgettable February 23, 2025, continues to bloom across two worlds. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile, my compass. I can’t wait to wrap you in a hug that spans continents, and whisper how endlessly grateful I am for you.
poem:
Across dunes and rivers we roam,  
Two hearts that forever call home.  
Your love, my compass, bright and true,  
In every sunrise, I find you.
